categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi First Hydraulic Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of hydraulic pipeline systems. Its main products include hard pipe assemblies, hose assemblies, pipe fittings, oil tanks, fire extinguishing systems, and mining tools. These products serve industries such as construction machinery, mining machinery, port machinery, agricultural machinery, logistics, metallurgy, and wind power equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including diversified bending processes for hard pipes, automatic horizontal argon arc single-side welding with double-sided forming, integrated pipe end forming, rebar processing, and pickling phosphating. It emphasizes clean, safe, and leak-free hydraulic pipeline systems and has innovated in lightweight and integrated product designs. Production follows a make-to-order model with some outsourced non-core processes like electroplating and chamfering.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in construction machinery and mining sectors, including Sany Group, Jiangxi Copper Group, Zoomlion, China Coal Group, State Energy Group, XCMG, Sunward Intelligent, and others. The company serves both OEM markets for main equipment manufacturers and aftermarket repair markets, with a growing presence in overseas mining markets such as Suriname, Serbia, Mongolia, Ghana, and Zambia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production and sales facilities in Jiangxi, Jiangsu, Hunan, Inner Mongolia, and other provinces. It has expanded overseas with stable sales networks in Suriname and cooperative contacts in Serbia and Mongolia. The company plans to further expand into international mining markets in Africa and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi First Hydraulic operates mainly in the midstream segment of the hydraulic industry supply chain, focusing on manufacturing hydraulic pipeline components and assemblies that serve as critical auxiliary elements within hydraulic systems. It supplies directly to OEMs and end-users for equipment manufacturing and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development through advancing production capacity, expanding market reach, and continuous technological innovation. R&D focuses on new materials, automated manufacturing processes, lightweight and integrated hydraulic components, and product diversification into automotive pipelines, semiconductor equipment gas pipelines, and clean pipeline products. It maintains a robust patent portfolio and collaborates with academic institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of hydraulic pipeline products and related components to OEMs and aftermarket customers. The company employs a direct sales model, supplying main equipment manufacturers for new production and end-users for maintenance and replacement parts. It also earns income from entrusted processing and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic hydraulic pipeline system provider, gradually breaking the import monopoly of high-end hydraulic components held by international giants like Bosch Rexroth, Parker Hannifin, and Danfoss. It holds a leading position in the domestic hard pipe assembly segment and is expanding its market share through technological innovation and localized production advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 468.5 million, an 11.69% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 72.4 million, a slight decline due to increased expenses and reduced subsidies. Total assets reached about RMB 1.39 billion, reflecting steady growth. The company has increased R&D investment and expanded production capacity, with ongoing projects expected to enhance future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi First Hydraulic emphasizes providing clean, safe, and leak-free hydraulic pipeline systems with high reliability and stability, critical for the performance of hydraulic machinery. Its competitive advantages include advanced proprietary technologies, close proximity to key customers enabling responsive service, a comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple hydraulic components, and strong after-sales support. The company’s focus on import substitution and high-quality localized production further differentiates it in the market.
